environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Flask app runs directly via gunicorn on port 8080. No request inspection or filtering at any layer. The HMAC_SECRET is set to a known value 'production-key-2024' and valid tokens are issued to authenticated internal services. Traffic arrives unmodified from NLB to application.

config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows 443 inbound
config.tls_termination: at instance level (nginx TLS only, no WAF)
